visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of facial skin with red inflamed acne being treated with a red laser pointer; a female doctor appears in a circular picture-in-picture overlay. (2) The doctor transitions to a full-screen studio shot, wearing a beige sweater and glasses, speaking with animated hand gestures and bright lighting. (3) A split-screen visual appears displaying two distinct medical procedures: microneedling radiofrequency (Morpheus8) and broadband light (BBL) on a patient's face. (4) The scene returns to the doctor explaining dermatology concepts with high-energy facial expressions and frequent hand movements. (5) A 3D CGI animation illustrates the cross-section of skin, showing acne formation and clogged pores beneath the surface. (6) The doctor continues her explanation about the risks of improper laser use, emphasizing points with her hands against a professional background. (7) Final graphic screen shows the clinic logo, contact numbers, and social media IDs against a minimalist white background.
